[There are hardly any words in real use in Sanskrit beginning
 with {#Ra#}. Many roots which, in the <ls>Dhātupāṭha.</ls>, are written with an
 initial {#Ra#} really begin with {#na#}. They are so written to show that
 the {#na#} is liable to be changed to {#Ra#} when preceded by prepositions,
 like {#pra, pari, antar#} <ab>&c.</ab>]
